clockNote: at is seconds from scenario start

scenarios.name: no_connect_req_while_a_session_is_believed_alive
scenarios.note: §4.4: a client must never connect_req over its own live session

scenarios.name: the_peer_connection_waits_for_the_access_code_exchange
scenarios.note: a second verified exchange for the same session never starts a second peer

scenarios.name: a_host_without_consent_starts_the_peer_as_soon_as_the_code_is_proved
scenarios.note: unattended access on: the code alone is permission

scenarios.name: an_exchange_that_never_verified_never_prompts
scenarios.note: a prompt for an unauthenticated controller would be a nuisance and a phishing vector

scenarios.name: consent_allowed_releases_the_held_peer_start
scenarios.note: no step timer runs during the wait; the answer is taken once

scenarios.name: an_unanswered_prompt_declines_after_exactly_30s
scenarios.note: the default answer is decline

scenarios.name: a_controller_that_gives_up_takes_the_prompt_with_it
scenarios.note: the controller's own bye{timeout} or bye{user_ended} arrives as closeLocally

scenarios.name: a_new_session_start_replaces_the_open_prompt
scenarios.note: at most one prompt at a time, and its timer restarts

scenarios.name: a_leftover_peer_never_turns_a_new_prompt_into_a_live_session
scenarios.note: review M-A: a compromised server pushes session_start for B while A's peer is up, then bounces A's ICE; B must never reach live, and Decline must still end B

scenarios.name: link_events_before_the_peer_starts_are_ignored
scenarios.note: only the peer connection the machine ordered can move the phase

scenarios.name: allow_is_ignored_for_the_first_1_5_s_of_a_prompt
scenarios.note: a click aimed at something else cannot land on Allow

scenarios.name: a_malformed_controller_device_id_is_shown_as_another_mac
scenarios.note: the prompt names only a well-formed Device ID

scenarios.name: a_controller_waits_45s_for_the_peer_before_giving_up
scenarios.note: longer than the host's 30 s prompt, so a slow Allow still connects

scenarios.name: a_declined_controller_closes_with_the_hosts_reason
scenarios.note: declined is terminal: no retry, no resume

scenarios.name: losing_signaling_does_not_tear_down_media
scenarios.note: the control plane dying must not interrupt an established media path

scenarios.name: resume_is_sent_even_when_hello_ok_has_no_active_session_id
scenarios.note: our own session record is enough; the server advertisement is a bonus

scenarios.name: a_failed_resume_frees_the_slot_and_tick_retries
scenarios.note: a transient error keeps the session and retries; only no_session/bad_token discard it

scenarios.name: renew_fires_on_schedule_and_not_before
scenarios.note: granted at t=0 with a 300s renew interval

scenarios.name: server_restart_with_a_remembered_code_reconnects_silently
scenarios.note: every session died with the server; prompting the user would be wrong

scenarios.name: a_host_never_silently_reconnects
scenarios.note: a host holds no access code to offer

scenarios.name: a_first_ice_failure_retries_on_relay_immediately_instead_of_waiting
scenarios.note: the 45s grace now covers the relay attempt, not a hopeless wait on the failed path

scenarios.name: the_relay_retry_is_offered_at_most_once_per_session
scenarios.note: relay is the last resort; failing on relay too must not loop

scenarios.name: a_session_that_is_already_relay_only_never_asks_for_a_relay_retry
scenarios.note: RC_ICE_POLICY=relay already: there is nothing left to fall back to

scenarios.name: a_host_never_offers_the_relay_retry
scenarios.note: only the offerer restarts ICE (§4.3 step 4)

scenarios.name: after_the_relay_retry_a_later_disconnect_restarts_on_relay_too
scenarios.note: the policy sticks for the rest of the session

scenarios.name: an_up_to_up_ice_change_does_not_spam_input_reset
scenarios.note: connected -> completed is not a gap; resetting would drop held keys mid-drag

scenarios.name: a_session_we_own_but_cannot_resume_is_discarded_not_surfaced_as_busy
scenarios.note: app restarted, token died with the process, server still advertises the session

scenarios.name: busy_against_our_own_session_clears_it_and_retries_exactly_once
scenarios.note: the second busy is a genuine second controller and must surface

scenarios.name: the_busy_retry_guard_survives_a_signaling_flap
scenarios.note: reconnecting re-advertises the stale session; without the one-shot guard connectFailed(busy) would bye-and-retry forever against a genuine second controller

scenarios.name: a_resumable_session_is_never_discarded
scenarios.note: holding a token means resume, never bye

scenarios.name: a_deliberately_closed_session_is_not_resurrected
scenarios.note: the regression the first stale-session fix caused: closed is closed
